package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

var lastName string

// byeHandler writes Goodbye, <name>! for the name query parameter, or world when it is empty.
func byeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	name := r.URL.Query().Get("name")
	if name == "" {
		name = "world"
	}
	lastName = name
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "Goodbye, %s!", name)
}
